description.value:
Consecrated wire-chain stripped from a decommissioned soul-battery harness and retrofitted for capture instead of containment failure. The setting's soul economy runs on exactly this kind of salvage — you just do it to things still screaming.

SIGNATURE — reaction when a Named creature within 30 feet drops to 0 HP or is otherwise defeated; instead of losing it, you bind it permanently into the Chain as a servant-spirit — no roll.

cinderfall.followUp: signature spell 'Binding Chain' is record wardbreaker.binding-chain-spell; the card renders on spells-abilities.html as a spell-entry and its statline/body are authored above
